_purpose: CA affordable / multifamily housing muni sector inventory. Scopes the wrap-cluster catalog prediction that federal-wrap structures (GNMA, FHA 221d4, FHA 542c) mask operator (project owner / property manager) credit signal. Identifies the actual structural cleavage: state-HFA-overcollateralization (CalHFA) and federal-wrap (GNMA / FHA 542c Risk-Share) on one side; uninsured single-asset essential / workforce housing on the other. The wrap-cluster catalog's primary prediction is partially confirmed at the issuer-aggregate (CalHFA) level but the more important finding is the existence of a separate, UNWRAPPED, project-level workforce-housing subsector that has materially defaulted in 2024-2025.
_session_notes: Time-boxed 90 min scoping. Universe inventory + structure classification + bond pricing anchors completed; per-project HUD REAC / LIHTC compliance / Section 8 status not pulled (data-gap).
Bond price anchors pulled via MunicipalBonds.com (full Chrome fingerprint) — primary source MSRB EMMA trade tape via aggregator.

Catalog prediction REVISED: the wrap-mask prediction holds for CalHFA (state-HFA overcollateralized) and project-level Freddie-TEL / GNMA-collateralized affordable deals, but the workforce/essential-housing subsector that does NOT use federal wraps shows MAXIMUM information content in bond prices — distressed projects trade 1500-2000+ bps wide vs CalHFA wrap.

Cross-vertical comparison: AGM rating-conditional finding (0 bps at AA-, 140 bps at BBB-, 360 bps at CCC-) applies analogously here — CalHFA Aa2/AA wrap on a portfolio of FHA-Risk-Share loans trades at +35-65 bps over MMD AAA = consistent with AA-wrap on portfolio-of-A1-underlying. Unwrapped single-asset workforce housing at sub-IG/distressed underlying trades ~1500-2500 bps wide.

calhfa_overcollateralized_program.description: CalHFA Affordable Multifamily Housing Revenue Bond Indenture (post-2023 reentry). Aa2 Moody's / AA S&P. 1.31x PADR (program-asset-to-debt ratio). Indenture funds a mix of FHA Risk Share, GNMA-collateralized, and uninsured permanent loans. The PROGRAM credit (CalHFA balance sheet) wraps over the underlying loan-level credit. Upgraded to Aa1 by Moody's in Jan 2026.
calhfa_overcollateralized_program.structural_wrap: state HFA balance-sheet overcollateralization + indenture lien on portfolio
calhfa_overcollateralized_program.predicted_masking: STRONG — operator-level signal absorbed by program overcollateralization

calhfa_conduit_supportive_housing.description: CalHFA acts as conduit for project-level supportive housing deals (e.g., 833 Bryant SF Supportive Housing). Bonds are non-recourse to CalHFA program credit and rely on project-level cash flow + Section 8 / HUD voucher pledge.
calhfa_conduit_supportive_housing.predicted_masking: PARTIAL — federal voucher backstop on rent revenue but not on debt service per se

freddie_mac_tel_passthrough.description: CSCDA / CMFA / CalPFA conduit issuance where Freddie Mac purchases the tax-exempt loan (TEL or Flex TEL) and provides credit enhancement via direct purchase. Bonds typically rated Aa2/AA (Freddie Mac credit) and structured as 30y term with 35y amort. Used predominantly on 4% LIHTC + tax-exempt PAB acquisitions / rehabs. Typical 2024 deals: Lexington Green ($42.9M, Ready Capital lender), Prospera at Homestead ($30.75M).
freddie_mac_tel_passthrough.structural_wrap: Freddie Mac TEL purchase / unconditional credit substitution
freddie_mac_tel_passthrough.current_market_yield_anchor: +30 to +50 bps over MMD AAA (extrapolated from Aaa-rated GSE muni paper)

gnma_collateralized_passthrough.description: Conduit-issued bonds collateralized by GNMA mortgage-backed securities backing the project mortgage. Full faith and credit of U.S. Government on principal & interest. Rated Aaa. Used on new-construction or acquisition-rehab deals where lender originates an FHA-insured mortgage and securitizes it. Less common in 2023-2025 than Freddie TEL — most California 4% LIHTC deals now go through Freddie.
gnma_collateralized_passthrough.structural_wrap: GNMA timely-pay guarantee = full federal faith & credit
gnma_collateralized_passthrough.current_market_yield_anchor: +15 to +30 bps over MMD AAA (UST-equivalent on tax-exempt scale)
gnma_collateralized_passthrough.predicted_masking: MAXIMUM — operator signal entirely absorbed by federal wrap

fha_542c_risk_share.description: FHA Section 542(c) Risk-Sharing Insurance. CalHFA underwrites the FHA insurance and shares 50% of any claim with HUD. State HFA bears half the claim risk. Mortgage insured via this program is then funded through the CalHFA Affordable Multifamily indenture. The credit-enhancement layer is HYBRID — partial federal, partial state HFA balance sheet.
fha_542c_risk_share.structural_wrap: FHA insurance with 50% state risk share = federal credit floor + state amortization
fha_542c_risk_share.current_market_yield_anchor: Embedded inside CalHFA Affordable Multifamily indenture; no standalone CUSIP

fha_221d4_new_construction.description: FHA Section 221(d)(4) multifamily mortgage insurance for new construction / substantial rehabilitation. 40-year fully-amortizing fixed-rate insurance. Typically used in conjunction with conduit short-term tax-exempt construction-period bonds + 4% LIHTC + GNMA permanent take-out. Bonds typically have 24-36 month construction period then taken out by GNMA securitization. Lender = Ready Capital / Walker Dunlop / Lument / etc.
fha_221d4_new_construction.structural_wrap: FHA insurance on permanent loan + GNMA on bond collateral
fha_221d4_new_construction.current_market_yield_anchor: Same as gnma_collateralized_passthrough during permanent phase; construction-period unrated

essential_workforce_housing_unwrapped.description: CSCDA Community Improvement Authority / California Community Housing Agency (CalCHA) / CMFA Special Finance Agency I / CalPFA workforce housing deals. Government joint-powers authority acquires market-rate apartment buildings and converts to 80-120% AMI rent caps. 2019-2021 vintage: ~45+ deals issued $8-10B. ZERO credit enhancement — purely project-level cash flow with senior/subordinate lien stack. 'Missing middle' workforce housing NOT eligible for tax credits or PAB allocation.
essential_workforce_housing_unwrapped.structural_wrap: NONE — bondholder underwrites single-asset apartment cash flow directly
essential_workforce_housing_unwrapped.current_market_yield_anchor: +200 to +250 bps over MMD AAA in 2021; now +500-2000 bps on distressed names trading 63-90 cents
essential_workforce_housing_unwrapped.predicted_masking: NONE — wrap-cluster prediction does NOT apply; project-level signal fully visible in price

lihtc_4pct_pab_unwrapped.description: 4% LIHTC + tax-exempt private activity bonds with no Freddie/Fannie/FHA/GNMA wrap. Bondholder relies on project NOI + 15-year LIHTC compliance. Less common than wrapped structures because investors demand credit enhancement; usually exists only on small deals or as junior tranches under a Freddie TEL senior.
lihtc_4pct_pab_unwrapped.structural_wrap: NONE; LIHTC compliance is operational not credit
lihtc_4pct_pab_unwrapped.current_market_yield_anchor: Limited public-trade data; private placements common

calpfa.role: Conduit for affordable multifamily and other public benefit issuances; smaller than CSCDA / CMFA in housing volume.

cdlac.role: Allocates federal tax-exempt private activity bond cap ($4.87B 2024 ceiling, demand >$12B). NOT an issuer — allocates capacity to conduits. 2024 awarded 138 of 354 multifamily applications (39%).
